title: Velvety Butternut Squash and White Bean Soup
intro: Skipping the peeling and chopping by using frozen butternut squash makes this hearty soup fast to prepare. Blended white beans create a creamy texture, finished with a dollop of Greek yogurt and crunchy pumpkin seeds.

ingredients.name: Low-sodium vegetable broth
ingredients.canonical_name: Soup, vegetable broth, low sodium, ready to serve

ingredients.name: No-salt-added canned Great Northern beans
ingredients.canonical_name: Beans, great northern, mature seeds, canned, low sodium

ingredients.name: Unsalted roasted pumpkin seeds (pepitas)
ingredients.canonical_name: Seeds, pumpkin and squash seed kernels, roasted, without salt added

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a medium pot over medium heat for 1 to 2 minutes, checking at 1 minute, until shimmering.
Add the frozen butternut squash, garlic powder, onion powder, and dried sage. Sauté for 4 to 5 minutes, checking at 4 minutes, until the squash softens.

Pour in the vegetable broth and stir in the rinsed Great Northern beans, salt, and black pepper. Bring to a boil over medium-high heat, then reduce the heat to medium-low. Simmer for 10 to 12 minutes, checking at 10 minutes, until the squash is tender.
Remove the pot from the heat. Purée the soup directly in the pot using an immersion blender until completely smooth.
Ladle the soup into bowls. Dollop the Greek yogurt into the center of each bowl and sprinkle with the pumpkin seeds before serving.
variation: Swap the dried sage for an equal amount of dried thyme.
conservation: Keeps 3-4 days refrigerated; reheat gently on the stovetop.
